senses.gloss: to stand, stand up, rise; to remain, endure; to be ready.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>אין עוֹמְדִין להתפלל וכ׳</he> you must not stand up (make ready) for prayer, &c., v. <cite ref="K00184"><he>כּוֹבֶד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:2">Ib. I, 2</cite> <he>שכן דרך … לַעֲמוֹד וכ׳</he> for princes generally rise at three hours.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:3">Ib. 3</cite> (expl. <he>ובקומך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:7">Deut. VI, 7</cite>) <he>בשעה שבני אדם עוֹמְדִים</he> at the time when people get up (in the morning).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71a:13">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>עוֹמֵד בחצי ימיו</he> a middle-aged man. Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ <he>ע׳ בדין</he> stood before court.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 47b:16">B. Mets. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שאינו עומד בדיבורו</he> who does not stand by (keep) his promise.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:4">Kil. IV, 4</cite> <he>העומד</he> that part of the fence which is unimpaired, opp. <he>פרוץ</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:3">Neg. I, 3</cite>, sq. <he>העומד</he> the leprous spot which remained in its place (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:28">Lev. XIII, 28</cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 60b:13">B. Bath. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>יכולין לעמוד בה</he>, v. <cite ref="C00581"><he>גְּזֵרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:5">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> <he>בקש משה שיַעַמְדּוּ וכו׳</he> Moses prayed that from him should rise priests and kings; a. v. fr.—Esp. uses: <he>ע׳ על</he>

senses.gloss: to understand. Y. Shek. I, 45ᵈ, v. אוֹפִי; a. e.—
senses.label: a

units: Meg. 28ᵃ לא עָמַדְתִּי על מדותי, v. מִדָּה. Kidd. l. c. מְעַמֵּד על מדותיו Pi. (Rashi מַעֲמִיד Hif.)—
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:8">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> <he>ע׳ על חמשים</he> it came down to fifty; a. fr.
senses.label: c

units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:11">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>חלב טהור עומד</he> milk of a clean animal curdles (can be made into cheese or butter).
<cite ref="Beitzah 28b:4">Bets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>סכין שעָמְדָה מותר וכ׳</he> a slaughtering knife which has become dull may be sharpened on the Holy Day.
<cite ref="Pesachim 13b">Pes. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל העומד לזרוק וכ׳</he> whatever is ready to be sprinkled, is considered as if it had been sprinkled.
<cite ref="Ketubot 51a">Keth. 51ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8">Cant. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>כל … לעמוד בזנות</he> he who can resister the temptation of lust; <he>כאילו עומד בשתיהן</he> as if he resisted both; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cause to stand, to place; to restore, preserve; to beget, produce. Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ top הַעֲמִידוּ בימה put the dais up (to hold court).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:6">Tam. V, 6</cite> <he>היה מַעֲמִיד וכ׳</he> made the unclean priests stand in the eastern gate.
<cite ref="Yevamot 62b:10">Yeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>הם הם הֶעֱמִידוּ תורה וכ׳</he> it was they who preserved the law (tradition) in those days.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:1">Ab. I, 1</cite> <he>הַעֲמִידוּ תלמידים הרבה</he> rear many scholars.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:21">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>ה׳ בנים</he> begot children.
Koh. R. to I, 4 מה היא עומדת מַעֲמֶדֶת what does ʿomadeth (ib.) mean? She (the earth) preserves, v. תַּפְקִיד.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:5">Gen. R. s. 90</cite> <he>שכל ארץ וארץ מעמדת פירותיה</he> each ground preserves its own fruits (when put into the ground).
Ib. דברים שהן מַעֲמִידִין substances which conserve, v. קִטְמִית; a. fr.—2) to change the standing of; to enlarge; to reduce.
<cite ref="Megillah 15b:10">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>שתי אמות היה והֶעֱמִידוֹ על וכ׳</he> it was two cubits long, and he extended it to twelve.

Macc. 24ᵃ (of the 613 laws of the Torah) בא דוד והֶעֱמִידָן על וכ׳ David came and brought them down to eleven (Ps. XV); בא עמוס והעמידן על אחת Amos came and reduced them to one (Am. V, 4).—3) ה׳ (על) עצמו to contain, check one’s self.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 72a:16">Snh. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>אין אדם מעמיד עצמו על ממונו</he> no one will restrain himself from defending his property.
Ib. 93ᵇ מַעֲמִידִין על עצמם בשעה וכ׳ they restrained themselves when they had a human need.—4) (of liquids) to make consistent, curdle.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite> <he>מעמידין אותן בקיבת נבלה</he> they make the cheese by putting into the milk rennet from an animal not ritually slaughtered.

Orl. I, 7 המעמיד בשרף הערלה if one curdles milk by means of a resinous substance (an acid) from an ‘uncircumcised’ tree (v. עָרְלָה); a. e.—5) ה׳ על חזקתו to let a thing stand on the basis of its presumptive condition, to assume that the ordinary condition has not changed.

<cite ref="Niddah 2a:15">Nidd. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>הַעֲמֵד אשה על חזקתה</he> assume that the woman has not changed her presumptive condition (of cleanness); <he>העמד דבר על חזקתו</he> assume everything to remain unchanged (until a change is proven).
<cite ref="Ketubot 75b">Keth. 75ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—6) <he>ה׳ על מדותיו</he> (sub. <he>עצמו</he>), v. supra.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71a">Kidd. 71ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: to place; part. pass. מְעוּמָּד, q. v.
